cues.title: 保持混合气相同，只改变光照
cues.titleEn: Hold the mixture fixed and change light
cues.caption: 相同甲烷—氯气混合物，一组遮光、一组在光亮处比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare identical methane–chlorine mixtures in darkness and in light.
cues.zh: 教材把两支装有相同混合气的试管倒置在饱和氯化钠溶液中。一组包上铝箔遮光，另一组置于光亮处，比较时尽量保持其他条件一致。左侧铝箔作了剖开显示，方便看见内部状态。这个对照关注的是光照条件，不是改变气体配比或换一种容器。
cues.en: The textbook compares two inverted tubes containing the same mixture over saturated sodium chloride solution. One is wrapped in foil; the other is exposed to light, with other conditions held alike. The foil is shown in cutaway so the unchanged interior remains visible. This comparison changes light, not gas composition or vessel type.

cues.title: 光先改变哪根键？
cues.titleEn: Which bond does light change first?
cues.caption: 吸收光后，Cl—Cl断裂成两个自由基。
cues.captionEn: Absorbed light splits Cl—Cl into two radicals.
cues.zh: 先看光照侧的颜色变浅，再放大一个氯分子。它吸收合适的光，氯氯键断裂，两个氯各保留一个未成对电子。圆点标出自由基，不是额外生成的原子。新鲜的暗样本没有这次光引发，所以保持原状。如果此后没有新的光，已经形成的自由基会立刻消失吗？先记住这两个圆点，后面沿着它们引出的反应继续看。
cues.en: First notice the fading illuminated sample. Now follow one chlorine molecule. Absorbed light breaks its bond, leaving one unpaired electron on each chlorine. The dots mark radicals, not newly created atoms. The fresh dark sample lacks this initiation event and stays unchanged. If no new light arrives, must radicals already present vanish at once? Keep track of these two dots as we follow the reaction they can start.

cues.title: 液滴与液面提供另一组证据
cues.titleEn: Look for droplets and liquid rise
cues.caption: 管壁出现有机液滴，HCl进入水相，气相减少而液面上升。
cues.captionEn: Organic droplets appear; HCl enters the aqueous phase and the liquid level rises as gas is removed.
cues.zh: 现在同时看管壁和液面。继续取代能够形成常温下可呈液态的有机产物，所以管壁出现油状液滴。生成的氯化氢容易进入水相，气相数量减少，液体进入管内。不要把液滴直接认作一氯甲烷：它在常温下是气体。液面和液滴只展示教材观察到的趋势，没有按真实汽液平衡预测高度或滴数。
cues.en: Now inspect the wall and liquid level. Further substitution produces organic compounds that can be liquid at room temperature, giving oily droplets. Hydrogen chloride enters the aqueous phase, removing gas and allowing the liquid level to rise. The droplets should not be labelled chloromethane, which is a gas at room temperature. Height and drop count illustrate textbook observations rather than a quantitative phase-equilibrium prediction.

cues.title: 自由基怎样把反应接下去？
cues.titleEn: How does a radical carry the reaction onward?
cues.caption: 一个Cl·被消耗，另一个Cl·产生；链可以继续。
cues.captionEn: One Cl· is consumed; another is produced to carry the chain.
cues.zh: 回到已经引发的样本，此后不再给新的光。一个氯自由基夺走甲烷的一个氢，形成氯化氢，碳上留下未成对电子。这个碳自由基再与一分子氯气反应：一个氯接到碳上，另一个成为新的氯自由基。新载体不是刚才那个氯原子，却能接着夺氢。现在它遇到同一碳骨架上剩下的氢，第二次取代继续了。再看两份氯自由基相遇，结合成氯分子，这条链就终止。跟踪对象始终是一个碳、四个氢和六个氯；这是一条可能的反应链，不是所有碰撞必走的路线，也不把动作秒数当反应速率。
cues.en: Return to the initiated sample, with no new light. A chlorine radical takes one hydrogen from methane, making hydrogen chloride and leaving an unpaired electron on carbon. The carbon radical reacts with a chlorine molecule. One chlorine bonds to carbon; the other becomes a new chlorine radical. It is a different atom, but the same kind of chain carrier. Now it encounters a remaining hydrogen on that carbon framework, allowing a second substitution. Finally, two chlorine radicals meet and combine. This chain ends. The same one carbon, four hydrogens and six chlorines remain throughout. This is one possible chain, not a prediction that every collision follows this route or that screen seconds measure reaction speed.

cues.title: 更多甲烷，为什么会改变混合物？
cues.titleEn: Why does extra methane change the mixture?
cues.caption: 仍有C—H的产物能再被选中；配比改变这种机会。
cues.captionEn: Products retaining C—H can be selected again; the ratio changes that opportunity.
cues.zh: 把视野拉开。每个格子仍是同一个碳，下面四点记录它的四个氢位置。同一个碳可能被选中不止一次，因此一氯产物与更深度取代的产物能够并存。现在固定八份氯气，把甲烷从八份增加到三十二份：哪一组会有更少的多取代分子？先作预测。若暂时假设所有剩余氢位置被选中的机会相同，更多尚未取代的位置会分走机会，重复选中减少。画面显示这个有限统计模型的平均份数，不是实验产率。真实产物的反应性并不相同；配比能帮助控制混合物，却不能凭一条总方程保证只有一氯甲烷。
cues.en: Widen the view. Each tile remains the same carbon, with four dots recording its original hydrogen sites. A carbon can be selected more than once, so monochlorinated and further substituted products can coexist. Keep eight chlorine units but increase methane from eight to thirty-two units. Which sample should have fewer multiply substituted molecules? Make a prediction. If all remaining hydrogen sites were equally likely to be selected, more untouched sites would compete for the same substitutions, reducing repeat selections. The numbers are mean amounts in this finite statistical model, not measured yields. Real products have different reactivities. Changing the ratio helps control the mixture; a single overall equation cannot guarantee chloromethane alone.

question.zh: 光为什么能引出一连串取代？
question.en: Why can light start a chain of substitutions?

lead.zh: 从P64–65的明暗对照出发，跟踪同一组原子，看新自由基如何把反应接下去。
lead.en: Start with the light–dark comparison on pages 64–65, then trace atoms as new radicals carry the reaction onward.

principle.zh: 光引发产生自由基；传播消耗一个载体又产生新载体，剩余C—H允许重复取代，终止消除载体。
principle.en: Light initiates radicals; propagation consumes one carrier and creates another. Remaining C—H allows further substitution, while termination removes carriers.

question.zh: Cl₂用量不变，增加甲烷，为什么可能减少多取代？
question.en: With fixed Cl₂, why can extra methane reduce multiple substitution?

explanation.zh: 更多未取代的C—H与已取代产物竞争。在等反应性位点模型中，同样次数的取代更分散；真实数值还取决于不同物种的反应性，不能由该模型保证纯品。
explanation.en: More untouched C—H sites compete with substituted products. Equal-site selections become less concentrated on the same carbon; real amounts also depend on differing reactivities, so the model does not guarantee a pure product.

topic.name: 光怎样启动甲烷取代链？
topic.nameEn: How does light start methane substitution?
topic.description: 从明暗对照追踪氯自由基、连续两次取代与有限配比预测。
topic.descriptionEn: Trace chlorine radicals from the light–dark comparison through repeated substitution and a finite-ratio prediction.
